name: coauth-history
description: Nodes represent authors. Each hyperedge represents a publication and contains the set of co-authors of that publication. This is a temporal higher-order network dataset, where each hyperedge is a publication marked with the History tag in the Microsoft Academic Graph. Timestamps are the year of publication.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., coauth-history).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

nodes_metadata.author: (STRING) Name of the Microsoft Academic Graph author represented by the node (e.g., Julian Preece).

edges_metadata.paper_title: (LIST[STRING]) Publication title or titles represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [The German Imagination and the Decline of the East]).
edges_metadata.time: (INT) Normalized publication year used by the temporal hypergraph (e.g., 204).
edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Number of publications collapsed into this author-set/year hyperedge (e.g., 2).
